title: Repair or replace the backflow preventer? Compare the whole closeout cost.
description: Use body condition, model support, failed components, labor, retest, and local reporting to compare repair with replacement.
prompt: Which fact changes the decision most?
answer: Replace is not automatically safer and repair is not automatically cheaper. The useful comparison includes the body, available parts, repeated failures, labor, retest, permits, and reporting.
urgency: A cracked or freeze-split body, uncontrolled discharge, or life-safety connection should not wait for a generic online cost comparison.
diagramAlt: Backflow assembly split into repairable internal parts and non-repairable damaged body
identifiers: Body intact and supported model: internal repair may be practical.
Cracked, distorted, badly corroded, or obsolete body: replacement becomes more likely.
Repeated failures: compare cumulative service and downtime, not only the next kit.

choices.label: The body is cracked or freeze-damaged
choices.detail: Replacement is more likely; verify piping and retest scope.

choices.label: The body is intact and one component failed
choices.detail: Ask for a model-specific repair and retest quote.

choices.label: The model or parts are uncertain
choices.detail: Record the complete nameplate before comparing quotes.

choices.label: The utility notice is driving the job
choices.detail: Check whether replacement triggers permits, testing, or reporting.

steps.title: Separate body from internals
steps.body: Seats, checks, seals, springs, and relief components are different from a cracked casting.

steps.title: Price the finished outcome
steps.body: Include labor, isolation, repair or assembly, piping changes, retest, filing, and downtime.

steps.title: Verify local closeout
steps.body: A replacement may still need installation approval, a passing test, and accepted submission.

safeChecks: Photograph the nameplate and whole installation.
Get repair and replacement scopes in writing.
Ask whether retest and report filing are included.
Check warranty and parts availability for the exact model.
stopConditions: Quote excludes mandatory retest or filing
notThisDevice: A cosmetic exterior stain does not prove the body has failed.
A failed check component does not automatically require a whole new assembly.
A successful mechanical repair does not automatically close the utility record.
evidenceNote: Cost language on this page is a decision framework, not a national price promise. Local labor, device size, permits, and utility requirements vary.
